about_the_game:
DEN PAIN — Original Game Soundtrack

Artists: y2k_jungle & Masha Sasi
Tracks: 34 original compositions

Composed by Masha Sasi in collaboration with y2k_jungle, this soundtrack delivers a hard-hitting, high-adrenaline score built for brutal, kinetic action—channeling the grit of Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days, the neon ferocity of Hotline Miami, and the cinematic punch of Max Payne 3. From claustrophobic bass and shattered breakbeats to pulse-pounding set-piece anthems, these 39 tracks are engineered to make every firefight hit harder.
